newsitem.title: USA: Reliance Acceptance to revise underwriting.
newsitem.headline: Reliance Acceptance to revise underwriting.

text.p: Reliance Acceptance Group Inc on Wednesday said it was changing its credit-underwriting practices because of unacceptable default rates, even though the move would reduce growth volume.
In addition, the specialty finance company said it had breached some loan agreements after disappointing performances in the past two quarters.

"The recent quarter's results caused us to breach certain covenants in our loan agreements, and I have initiated discussions with our lenders in order to assure their confidence and continued support," said Howard Silverman, who assumed the duties of chief executive with the resignation of Thomas Barlow, announced on Wednesday.

Earlier, the company posted a first-quarter net loss from continuing operations of $9.9 million, or $0.76 per share, compared with profit from continuing operations of $3.2 million, or $0.21, in the year-earlier quarter.
